name: BRACOL: A Brazilian Arabica Coffee Leaf Images Dataset for Identification and Quantification of Diseases and Pests
description: BRACOL is an authentic agricultural benchmark dataset comprising 1,747 full-leaf photographs and 2,147 cropped symptom patches of Arabica coffee leaves (Coffea arabica L.) collected in the mountainous region of Santa Maria de Marechal Floriano, Espírito Santo, Brazil. Photographed from the abaxial (lower) side of leaves using multiple smartphone models (ASUS Zenfone 2, Xiaomi Redmi 5A, Xiaomi S2, Samsung Galaxy S8, and iPhone 6S) on uniform white backgrounds, the dataset captures healthy foliage alongside leaves afflicted by major biotic stresses: leaf miner, leaf rust, brown leaf spot, and cercospora leaf spot. Accompanied by expert diagnostic annotations and pixel-level symptom masks, BRACOL supports multi-label classification, symptom segmentation, and ordinal disease severity grading.
